title: Write it up
drDigitalIntro:
Back home. Dr. Digital wants a note about the trip, formatted properly.
There are no step-by-step instructions here. You get a list of things to accomplish and you decide how.
• Nothing glows yellow. No control is highlighted.
• Do the objectives in any order.
• Open the checklist with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
• The Hint button gives a nudge toward where to look — never the answer.

This one is keyboard only — the toolbar buttons will not count.

playgroundTask.goal: You formatted a note using only the keyboard
playgroundTask.hint: Every one of these is the Control key (or Command on a Mac) held down with a single letter. The letter is usually the first letter of the word.

steps.say: There is something written in the editor.
A copy of it is on the clipboard.
The last change has been undone.

drDigitalSuccess: Bold, italic, copy and undo without touching the mouse once. That is faster than any toolbar.
drDigitalHint: Hold Control (or Command) and press a single letter. B, I, A, C and Z are the ones you need.
warning: Use the keyboard for this one — clicking the toolbar buttons will not count.
